name: onenote-mcp
description: Read, write, and organize local Microsoft OneNote notebooks (Windows only), both from local backups and live via the running OneNote app. No account, API key, or Azure setup needed.
long_description:
Gives Claude direct access to local Microsoft OneNote notebooks on Windows. Reads from OneNote's local backup snapshots for quick browsing and search (including OCR text from embedded images), and drives the running OneNote desktop app via its COM API for always-current reads plus writing and organizing: creating, renaming, moving, and deleting sections, section groups, and pages (deletes require explicit confirmation and only move items to the recycle bin), and inserting images from a local file path.

Also edits existing pages directly -- find/replace exact text, or replace the last content block -- with undo and redo backed by a persistent action log (history.md) that survives restarts, so a mistaken edit can be reversed (and a mistaken undo redone) without digging through OneNote's own recycle bin by hand.

Originally created by mhzarem (https://github.com/mhzarem/onenote-mcp) under the MIT license. This is a modified, substantially extended derivative by Rail1337 -- not the original author. Stays open source under the same MIT license.

tools.description: List sections in a notebook

tools.name: read_section
tools.description: Read all text content of a section (from local backup)

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search text across every notebook and section

tools.name: list_all_sections
tools.description: Full overview of every section in every notebook

tools.name: get_notebook_summary
tools.description: Notebook overview with content previews

tools.name: list_live_notebooks
tools.description: List notebooks/sections currently open in OneNote

tools.name: create_section
tools.description: Create a brand-new section in a notebook

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a new page in a section

tools.name: list_live_pages
tools.description: List pages in a section, with IDs for reading/appending

tools.name: read_live_page
tools.description: Read the full text of a single live page

tools.name: read_live_section
tools.description: Read every page in a section, live

tools.name: append_to_page
tools.description: Append content to an existing page

tools.name: create_section_group

tools.name: move_section
tools.description: Move a section to a different section group, or restore one from the recycle bin

tools.name: rename_section
tools.description: Rename an existing section

tools.name: rename_page
tools.description: Rename an existing page's title

tools.name: delete_section
tools.description: Delete a section (recycle bin, requires confirm=true)

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete a page (recycle bin, requires confirm=true)

tools.name: list_recycle_bin
tools.description: List sections and pages currently in a notebook's recycle bin

tools.name: insert_image_from_file
tools.description: Insert an image onto a page from a local file path (or bare filename in the default Downloads folder)

tools.name: find_and_replace_in_page
